findings.finding: The exact held source is a five-page flat FDLE PDF, printed FDLE40-025 and Revised July 2022.
findings.consequence: The build asserts the assigned SHA-256 and byte length, overlays measured participant fields, and preserves all five pages.

findings.finding: The prosecutor statement, notary acknowledgment, fingerprint-official fields, fingerprint impressions, and participant signature/date fields have separate completion owners.
findings.consequence: Every one remains blank and the participant instructions name who completes it.

findings.finding: The official checklist requires the written certified statement, completion documentation, physical fingerprints, and original documents; it expressly excludes the $75 fee for juvenile-diversion expunction.
findings.consequence: Each required submission item is disclosed, and no absent certification, completion proof, or fingerprint card is represented as present.
